description: Source code for a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM dashboard widget class 'MyPipelineBySalesStageDashlet' that generates a chart visualizing sales pipeline data by sales stage, including methods for rendering options, display, data retrieval, and chart preparation.

classes.name: MyPipelineBySalesStageDashlet
classes.description: A dashboard dashlet class extending DashletGenericChart, used to display a sales pipeline chart grouped by sales stages with configurable date range and sales stages.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet with default date range and title if not provided.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Prepares and displays options for sales stages filtering.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the HTML and JavaScript for rendering the chart with data fetched from the database.

methods.name: getChartData
methods.description: Retrieves and orders chart data based on the constructed SQL query, aligning with selected sales stages.

methods.name: getHorizBarTotal
methods.description: Calculates total sum of dataset values.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL query to fetch opportunities grouped by sales stage and user, filtered by date range and sales stages.

methods.name: constructGroupBy
methods.description: Defines grouping fields for the SQL query.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Processes raw data into chart-ready format including labels, data points, tooltips, and total.
